post.description: Step 1: e-mail and password. Returns a challenge to complete with a TOTP code.
Step 2: the 6-digit code. Starts a browser session (cookie) or returns tokens for the app.
App only: exchange a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token (rotation).
End this session: the device row is deleted, so its cookie or refresh token stops working.

post.description: Step 1 of adding a passkey: options for navigator.credentials.create().
Step 2: verify the new credential and keep its public key.
Step 1 of signing in: options for navigator.credentials.get(). No e-mail needed.
Step 2: verify the signature and start a session, like password + TOTP would.
E-mail a recovery link. The answer is the same whether or not the account exists.
Choose a new password with the link's token and a code. Signs every session out.

get.description: Which extra sign-in methods this instance offers (public: the sign-in screen asks).
Off to Google. `link` needs a signed-in session (Profile → Account → Sign-in methods).
Back from Google: link the account, or sign in the one linked to it.

delete.description: Unlink Google. Another strong method must remain: password with TOTP, or a passkey.

post.description: Step 1: setup code, name, e-mail and password. Returns the TOTP key for step 2.
Step 2: a code from the app turns two-step verification on, closes sign-up and signs in.
